components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: High-intent conversion button used for RFQs and series exploration.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #F97316; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 10px 22px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ea580c; transform: translateY(-1px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(249,115,22,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Authoritative navy button used for navigation, catalog filters, and secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #020617; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #334155; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Technical Input Field
components.description: Form input styled for engineering RFQ entries and parametric searches.
components.css: .ds-input-wrapper { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; } .ds-input-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #020617; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-input-field { width: 100%; background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.3); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #020617; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input-field:focus { border-color: #F97316; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #F97316; background: #ffffff; }

components.name: Series Filter Tab
components.description: Filter tab for series directory and product category switching.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #f8fafc; color: #334155; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #F97316; color: #F97316; background: #ffffff; } .ds-chip-active { background: #020617; color: #ffffff; border-color: #020617; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Technical Specification Badge
components.description: Compact technical label for IP ratings, material certifications, and status indicators.
components.css: .ds-badge-spec { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.1); color: #F97316; border: 1px solid rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.3); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #F97316; }

narrative.overview:
PlastoGuard's visual system evokes the cleanliness, exactness, and mechanical certainty of a high-end electronics prototyping and testing laboratory. Enclosure models are engineered hardware products, not consumer gadgets; every surface communicates dimensional precision, ingress protection integrity, and factory-direct capability. The interface uses generous, cool-tinted negative space (Technical Surface Ice) overlaid with subtle CAD-inspired blueprint dot grids, crisp drafting borders, and authoritative Machinery Deep Navy structural headers.

Signal Safety Orange is deployed as a high-contrast functional accent—mirroring physical safety flags, IP rating seals, and urgent procurement triggers. Typography balances the architectural solidity of Hanken Grotesk for section titles with the immaculate legibility of Inter for specifications, punctuated by JetBrains Mono for exact dimensions, SKUs, and tolerances.

The visual system strictly avoids consumer e-commerce frivolity: no soft pastel gradients, no bubbly floating cards, and no generic office stock photography. Every piece of imagery focuses on authentic plastic injection enclosures, precision CNC milling details, PCB mounting bosses, and real manufacturing assets.
keyCharacteristics: CAD Drafting Precision: Clean 1px boundary lines (#334155 at low opacity), blueprint dot grids, and monospace technical labels.
High-Contrast Safety Accents: Purposeful Signal Safety Orange (#F97316) reserved for primary RFQ actions, verified IP badges, and series flags.
Physical Hardware Depth: Surfaces sit flat or subtly grounded at rest (shadow-sm), elevating with tangible lift (-translate-y-1.5 and shadow-xl) on hover.
Spec-First Hierarchy: Technical measurements (L × W × H mm), material compounds (Polycarbonate/ABS), and ingress seals take visual priority over generic sales copy.

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Signal Safety Orange is strictly reserved for actionable moments, active states, and verified certification emblems. It never coats whole backgrounds or decorative flourishes.

rules.name: The Blueprint Framing Rule
rules.body: Secondary cards and structural panels must use hairline 1px CAD borders (#334155 at 15–30% opacity) rather than heavy drop shadows to define boundaries.

rules.name: The Spec-Mono Rule
rules.body: All numeric measurements (mm, IP ratings, operating temperatures, PCB mounting hole dimensions, and product SKU codes) must be rendered in JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The Architectural Heading Rule
rules.body: Section headlines in Hanken Grotesk must always be paired with an uppercase JetBrains Mono eyebrow category label above them.

rules.name: The Hardware Elevation Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast heavy shadows while at rest. Elevation is an active response to user focus or cursor hover, reinforcing tactile inspection.

dos: Do format all dimensions in millimetres using JetBrains Mono (e.g. 150 × 100 × 60 mm).
Do pair every section title with an uppercase mono eyebrow tracking badge in Signal Safety Orange.
Do use hairline CAD Slate borders (1px solid rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.2)) to delineate specifications tables and cards.
Do ensure interactive cards lift smoothly on hover (hover:-translate-y-1.5 with duration-300).
Do feature verified ingress protection ratings (IP65, IP67, NEMA 4X) prominently in badge callouts.
donts: Don't use pastel, neon, or gradient backgrounds behind technical enclosure photography.
Don't apply full-screen saturated orange backgrounds; orange is strictly a signal and CTA accent.
Don't use generic stock photography of smiling corporate office workers; use genuine enclosure CAD renders, CNC machining tools, or physical product models.
Don't use low-contrast gray text on gray backgrounds; maintain high-contrast dark text (#0b1c30 or #020617) for engineering spec legibility.
Don't round corners excessively into cartoonish bubbles; maintain crisp 2px to 16px industrial engineering radii.
